attributes.action: Increase Penalties for Illegal Fly-Camping in the Lake District
attributes.additional_details:
The Lake District National Park is one of the UK's most valued landscapes. 

We are concerned about illegal and irresponsible fly-camping, including abandoned tents and equipment, litter, human waste, inappropriate fires, damage to vegetation, pollution and anti-social behaviour.

We therefore call on the UK Government to enable fines of up to £1,000 for serious or repeated illegal fly-camping and associated environmental damage in the Lake District National Park.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government to increase the maximum penalties for illegal fly-camping in the Lake District National Park to up to £1,000, particularly for serious or repeated offences and environmental damage, while protecting responsible low-impact outdoor recreation.
